title: This Land is Your Land
audio_note: 本课 MP3 包含《This Land Is Your Land》的歌曲表演。该歌曲属于第三方版权内容，VOA Learning English 的自制内容转载政策不覆盖第三方素材。因此本站不提供此 MP3 的本地缓存；请在 VOA 官方页面在线播放。

transcript: You know I love Washington, D.C. But I want to see more of the United States. My roommate Marsha and I will be on vacation at the same time. So, we are going on a road trip together!
I packed my bags and I am ready to go!
Did you make a list of all the places you want to see?
I did. I want to see New York City and the Statue of Liberty!
And I want to see Mount Rushmore!
And don’t forget the Grand Canyon!
(Anna writes) Let’s not forget California’s redwood forest! There are so many places to see!
We will be driving for a long time. So, we might get bored.
Bored? No way! We can talk.
We can play word games. We can sing! You know, our trip is like that famous American song.
Anna and Marsha sing a portion of “This Land Is Your Land”; song lyrics are omitted here.
Marsha, we just left D.C.! We’ll be eating lunch in about 2 hours. Can you wait?
Here, have an apple. It’s organic!
(Anna throws the apple. It goes out the window.)
Okay, we will be arriving in New York City very soon!
I can’t wait to see The Big Apple! Marsha, look! There she is!
Marsha, in ten minutes, guess what we’ll be seeing?
The largest rocking chair in the world!
No, we won’t be seeing that.
Marsha, it’s on my other list -- Best Roadside Sights.
(Marsha grabs the paper and throws it out the window.)
Oh no! We littered! And my list is gone. Don't worry. I brought the book. (lifts up large book, starts reading)
… and that is why I am so afraid of sheep.
Wow, I feel better. Marsha, you are a great listener.
We will be entering North Dakota any minute now!
North Dakota! We are going in the wrong direction! We want to go to South Dakota!
No problem. I will just exit the highway. We will be going south … in just a minute. There. Done! We're going south! Okay, we will be stopping for gas and a bathroom break in about an hour.
Then we will be very near to Mount Rushmore!
Yay! Dead presidents’ heads on the side of a mountain!
We did it, Marsha! We made it to California! It’s beautiful!
And we saw everything on the list!
Well, we saw everything on page 1 of the list.
Oh. Here are pages 2, 3 and 4! We’ll be very busy driving back to Washington, D.C. Until next time … !
